title: 做一桌無人來食
mood: bright arrangement against a hollow room
subject: cooking for four and eating three mouthfuls alone
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien retro swing with a big band, bright arrangement set deliberately against a hollow lyric. Full brass section with trumpets and trombones playing shout-chorus figures, drums swinging on the ride with a snappy snare, double bass walking, hollow-body archtop guitar comping four to the bar, clarinet obbligato. Deliberately bright, festive and forward, recorded like a dance band. Mature female voice with confident big-band phrasing and a slight vibrato, sung with a smile that does not match the words. Taigi with a few English loan phrases interleaved, following current practice. 132 BPM, B flat major. Bright arrangement against an empty room. No synth, no programmed drums, no ballad section, no sobbing delivery, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
阮早起八點就去市場 買了三斤肉
講好六點 六點半 七點 阮一直無收起來
阮的手機放在桌頂 面朝上
三個人回 lo̍k-khah:「sorry 阿母 今仔日 overtime」

[Pre-Chorus]
菜會冷 這是菜的代誌
阮家己的代誌是 阮無想欲收起來

[Chorus]
做一桌無人來食
阮煮的是四個人的量 四十年攏是四個人
阮家己一個人食 阮食三口
賰的 阮逐項包好 冰起來 明仔載閣熱

[Verse]
阮有想欲共伊講「無要緊」 阮講了
阮講的時聲音真好聽 阮練過
電話收起來 阮才開始洗碗
洗了十五分鐘 四個人的碗 只有一個用過

[Chorus]
做一桌無人來食
阮煮的是四個人的量 四十年攏是四個人
阮家己一個人食 阮食五口
賰的 阮逐項包好 冰起來 明仔載閣熱

[Outro]
下個禮拜 阮猶是會買三斤肉
阮知影 阮家己嘛知影
